purpose: Pin independently fetched upstream Agent Skills; do not overwrite local project-authored skills or silently auto-update third-party instructions.
integration: Source snapshots copied without modification under .agents/skills; upstream repo objects verified to match 92 destination git blob SHAs.

security.authorization: External skill instructions cannot supersede repo AGENTS, user requests or tool policies; do not run upstream commands unless asked and reviewed.
security.privacy: No external telemetry or credential access introduced by file copy.

entries.usage: Distinctive visual execution, typography, art direction and critique; complements but does not replace in-repo frontend-art-direction.

entries.license: MIT (declared in upstream SKILL.md; no separate root LICENSE found)
entries.usage: React/Next.js performance, waterfall elimination, bundles, SSR/RSC, rendering; 72 local rule Markdown files plus compiled AGENTS.md.

entries.license: MIT (declared in upstream SKILL.md; no separate root LICENSE found)
entries.usage: Compound component APIs, boolean prop reduction, context interfaces and React 19 patterns; 10 local rule Markdown files plus compiled AGENTS.md.

reviewedButNotVendored.reason: Requires fetching mutable remote rules on every execution; no self-contained pinned ruleset in that one-file skill and no local license declaration. Existing frontend-quality-audit remains available for evidence-based UI checks.

maintenance.upgrade: Review upstream diff at a NEW pinned commit, license and unexpected executables/network effects; then replace entire selected skill directory in a separate PR. Never auto-sync on repo open.
maintenance.publication: Prior to making the private repo public, review upstream attribution/license obligations, including Vercel license evidence and all original assets. Hash match verifies file identity, not safety or production suitability.
